text.tspan: November 15th 1946
Today I saw that the mail man is missing
in the local news paper. The last place he
was seen was our house. Everyone is
suspicious of us, including myself. I am
convinced now, that me and my family have
been expiriencing demonic possession, not
mere sleep walking. My sister is definately
hiding something, but a look in her eyes
scares me enough to not try and find out.
My mom's headaches are worse, and
she keeps stressing about her hair loss.
She seems desperate for her headaches
to stop and for her hair to grow.
November 16th 1946
When I was practicing piano today, I
heard voices telling me to play something.
They told me to play Fur Elise, but I didn't
want to. They were so loud though, so
eventually I complied. The whole time I
played they were chanting "Hide and
Seek, Hide and Seek, Hide and Seek..."
I thought it was very creepy, because just
an hour earlier, I was playing hide and
seek with Rosie. Finally, the deer head on
the wall came to life, with its eyes glowing
and screamed. All the lights went out.
All of the sudden, the piano opened and
a ladder shot up. A secret room opened
was just revealed, and the lights came
back on.
